struct Runner {
  func inOrderSteps(_ items: [() async throws -> Void], reason: String) async throws {
    for item in items {
      // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
      try await client.put(item)
      // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
      try await audit.save(item)
    }
  }
}

func use() async throws {
  try await Runner().inOrderSteps([], reason: "Each update reads the previous write")
}
